input.selectedRowRule: Exactly one JSONL object with pdbId equal to 1G6V; raw-line hash excludes the line-feed terminator.

positiveSourceFacts.fact: The complete retained inventory contains a 260-residue carbonic-anhydrase entity annotated as Bos taurus with UniProt P00921, and a 126-residue antibody-heavy-chain entity annotated as Camelus dromedarius. Entity 2 is the numbered-heavy lead.
The deposited entry title names camelid heavy-chain antibody fragment CAB-CA05 in a complex with bovine carbonic anhydrase.
Fresh exact-identifier Europe PMC/PubMed and Crossref bibliography match DOI 10.1074/jbc.m102107200 and a publication describing a camel single-domain antibody.

auditInference.statement: The domain-screen lead has positive camel single-domain-antibody bibliography and deposited CAB-CA05/carbonic-anhydrase context. This supports a bounded format and target-context review lead, without providing the primary preparation-to-deposition construct mapping required for formal eligibility or exclusion.
notEstablished: Exact expressed CAB-CA05 construct sequence, purification tags or processing from primary preparation Methods.
A primary preparation/deposition statement tying the complete candidate construct to the named reagent.
Direct-interface evidence, binder ancestry or formal overlap disposition.
A source-reviewed direct GPCR–VHH pair meeting frozen eligibility criteria.

auditInference.annotationCaveat: The CAB-CA05 identity and carbonic-anhydrase complex are deposited title/metadata statements. The matched bibliography establishes publication identity and single-domain-antibody context; it is not a preparation, direct-interface or affinity-validation record. Sequence length and camelid taxonomy alone carry no eligibility authority.

continuation: Retain the positive format/target context without converting it into a formal disposition. If formal disposition is required, obtain permitted primary preparation/construct and deposition evidence. Do not repeatedly retry the same failed publisher route without new access evidence.
scopeLimit: This review concerns only 1G6V and its 2 deposited polymer entities. It supplies neither an absence proof nor any bound for the phrase-only remainder or whole census.
